components.css: .ds-slide{font-family:"Source Sans 3",sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);border:0;background:none;transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease;}.ds-slide{padding:5px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:3px;flex:0 0 auto;scroll-snap-align:center}.ds-slide[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--accent,#a93f36);background:var(--accent-soft,#ecd5c8)}.ds-slide canvas{height:88px;width:auto;display:block;background:var(--stage,#dedbd1)}.ds-slide span{display:block;font-size:12px;text-align:left;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted,#66645e);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-slide:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]){transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-slide:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--hover,#e5e0d5)}.ds-slide:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}.ds-slide:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}.ds-slide[aria-pressed=true]:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#ecd5c8)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-slide{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The Photography Light Table uses a single cream and sand visual system, warm gray structure, charcoal text, and restrained coral interaction accents. Source Serif 4 gives the identity a composed serif voice; Source Sans 3 keeps photographs, measurements, and settings readable.

Working surfaces stay flat and compact. Photograph frames remain separate from the interface palette. The current implementation in styles.css and index.html is normative; the editor uses plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
keyCharacteristics: One fixed light palette; no theme switch.
Serif identity with sans-serif filenames and controls.
Fine borders, small corner radii, and restrained selection states.
dos: Do use the fixed cream, sand, gray, and coral world.
Do use the darker functional accent for readable actions, selection, and focus.
Do keep Source Serif 4 for the identity and invitation, and Source Sans 3 for editor controls.
Do keep visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, and photograph proportions.
Do keep copy functional and upload access to one Add photos action.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark/light themes, gold accents, or the previous fonts.
Don't add preloaded photographs, marketing sentences, or repeated explanatory copy.
Don't add film counters or barcodes; the film lettering is 35mm only.
Don't turn photographs or settings into decorative cards or add conspicuous motion.
